blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Vision-language models (VLMs) may accept false visual premises, answering questions about a target object’s color, count, location, or state even when it is absent. We call this reliability-critical behavior a target-absence grounding failure. Existing visual-grounding detectors primarily rely on generated responses, hidden states, or uncertainty measures. We present the first framework to leverage internal routing decisions in Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) VLMs to detect target absence before generation and guide selective correction. We extract target-token routing probabilities from Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct and Gemma-4-26B-A4B-it, train a separate L2-regularized linear detector for each model, and use its predictions to selectively invoke a target-aware review prompt. Using routing alone, the Qwen and Gemma detectors achieve ROC-AUCs of 0.9988 and 0.9956 on GQA-Inpaint and retain 0.8095 and 0.7781 on the external OBER dataset, respectively. The resulting routing-gated policy improves end-to-end accuracy on GQA-Inpaint and OBER by +22.25% and +12.17% for Qwen, and by +13.42% and +1.39% for Gemma, without modifying model weights. Further analysis shows that the signal is localized to the target-object token, emerges in early MoE layers, and is distributed across partially substitutable experts. Although cross-dataset threshold shifts require recalibration, false-positive review causes limited harm overall, suggesting that intervention risk can be controlled through joint selection of the detector threshold and review prompt. Overall, we show that routing probabilities alone preserve actionable information about visual perception, allowing computation already produced by an MoE VLM to support low-cost detection and selective visual regrounding.
blocks.zh: 视觉语言模型(VLMs)可能接受假视觉前提,回答有关目标对象的颜色,计数,位置,或状态的问题,即使没有. 我们把这个可靠性的关键行为 称为目标缺失 地面故障。 现有的目视定位探测器主要依靠生成的响应,隐藏状态,或不确定性措施. 我们提出第一个框架,以利用专家组合中的内部路径决定,在生成前发现目标缺失,并指导选择性修正。 我们从Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct和Gemma-4-26B-A4B-it中提取目标-token的路由概率,为每个模型单独训练一个L2-正规线性探测器,并利用其预测有选择地引用目标-意识审查的提示. blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Vision-language models (VLMs) perform strongly on visual question answering and multimodal reasoning, yet their answers are not always grounded in the image. A consequential failure arises when a question contains a false visual premise. Given an image with no dog, for example, a model may answer “What color is the dog?” with a plausible color. Here, the object is supplied by the question, and the model accepts its premise and fabricates the requested attribute. We call this behavior a target-absence grounding failure . Such answers can appear fluent and task-responsive because the prompt requests an attribute rather than an explicit existence judgment, obscuring the missing visual evidence and motivating detection before a response is produced.
blocks.zh: 视觉语言模型(VLMs)在视觉问答和多式联运推理方面表现强劲,但其答案并不总是以图像为基础. 如果一个问题包含一个虚假的视觉前提,就会产生相应的失败. 例如,鉴于一个没有狗的形象,一个模型可能用一种可信的颜色回答“狗是什么颜色?” 在此,对象由问题提供,模型接受它的前提,并编织所请求的属性. 我们称这种行为是目标缺失 地面故障。 这些答案看起来是流利的和任务响应的,因为即时请求的是属性而不是明确的存在判断,掩盖了缺失的视觉证据,并促使在做出回应之前进行检测.

blocks.en: Prior work evaluates object hallucination and false-premise questions through absent-object and object-removal benchmarks ( Li et al., 2023 ; Lovenia et al., 2024 ; He et al., 2025 ) . Rechecking the image, using an external verifier, or consulting a stronger model may mitigate such errors, but doing so for every input adds inference cost. Existing detectors primarily use generated responses, hidden states, or uncertainty measures ( Li et al., 2024 ; Kogilathota et al., 2026 ) . Mixture-of-experts VLMs (MoE VLMs) expose a different signal: at every layer, a router already assigns each token to a subset of experts, providing a structured record of how computation is allocated and a direct opportunity to test whether visual support is reflected in that allocation ( Shazeer et al., 2017 ; Fedus et al., 2022 ) . Whether this MoE-specific routing signal reveals target absence before generation, where it is located, and whether it can support selective correction remain unclear.
blocks.zh: 先前的工作通过缺席对象和物体清除基准评价物体幻觉和假真问题(Li等人,2023年;Lovenia等人,2024年;He等人,2025年)。 重新检查图像,使用外部验证器,或咨询更强的模型,可能减轻这种错误,但每次输入都会增加推论成本。 现有探测器主要使用生成的响应,隐藏状态,或不确定性措施(Li等人,2024年;Kogilathota等人,2026年). Mixture-of-experients VLMs (MoE VLMs) 暴露出不同的信号:在每一层,一个路由器已经向一个子集的专家分配了每个令牌,提供了计算分配的结构化记录,并提供了测试视觉支持是否反映在该分配中的直接机会(Shazeer等人,2017年;Fedus等人,2022年). 这个针对教育部的路由信号是否在生成前就显示目标缺失,位于何处,是否能够支持选择性修正,仍然不清楚.

blocks.en: We study these questions using Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct as the primary model and Gemma-4-26B-A4B-it to evaluate cross-model generalization. Our detect-then-review framework identifies the target noun phrase, maps it to tokenizer positions, and extracts routing probabilities specifically at that span across layers. A model-specific L2-regularized linear probe predicts target absence from this representation. Its prediction serves as a gate: predicted-present inputs retain the standard response, whereas predicted-absent inputs receive a target-aware review request. No model weights or router parameters are changed.
blocks.zh: 我们以Qune3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct作为主要模型和Gemma-4-26B-A4B-it来研究这些问题,评价跨模型的泛化. 我们的检测-当时审查框架确定目标名词短语,将其映射到示意器位置,并提取具体跨层的路由概率。 一个模型特异性的L2-正规线性探测器预测了这个表示中的目标缺失. 它的预测是一个门:预测的现成投入保留标准响应,而预测的现成投入则收到目标意识审查请求. 没有改变模型加权数或路由器参数.

blocks.en: On GQA-Inpaint, the Qwen and Gemma routing probes reach test ROC-AUCs of 0.9988 and 0.9956, respectively. Their ranking signal transfers to the external OBER dataset, where the corresponding ROC-AUCs are 0.8095 and 0.7781, although a threshold calibrated on GQA transfers less reliably. When used to gate target-aware review, the method improves end-to-end accuracy for both models and on both datasets; for Qwen, the gains are 22.25 percentage points on GQA-Inpaint and 12.17 points on OBER. Further analysis shows that the signal emerges in early MoE layers and is distributed across many experts. False-positive review causes limited harm overall, although cross-dataset threshold shifts show that the ranking signal transfers more reliably than a fixed decision threshold.
blocks.zh: 在GQA-Inpaint上,Quen和Gemma的路由探测器分别达到0.998和0.9956的ROC-AUC的测试. 他们的排名信号传输到外部的OBER数据集,其中相应的ROC-AUC为0.8095和0.7781,尽管在GQA传输上一个阈值校准不太可靠. 当用于锁定目标意识审查时,该方法提高了两个模型和两个数据集的端对端精度;对Quen来说,GQA-Inpaint的得分是22.25个百分点,OBER的得分是12.17个百分点. 进一步的分析表明,信号在早期的教育部层中出现,并分布在许多专家中. 假阳性审查在总体上造成的危害有限,尽管跨数据集阈值变化表明排名信号转移比固定决定阈值更可靠.

blocks.en: These results reveal a mismatch between internal routing and final behavior: routing can detect missing visual evidence that the answer ultimately ignores. Routing can thus support both expert interpretation and low-cost monitoring of visual grounding, turning an interpretability observation into an actionable inference policy without an external vision model or repeated decoding. Selective review concentrates additional inference on likely failures rather than every request. Consequently, the extra review cost is incurred only on the triggered subset, reducing the expected inference overhead relative to reviewing every input.
blocks.zh: 这些结果揭示了内部的路由与最终行为之间的不匹配:路由可以检测缺失的视觉证据,而答案最终会忽略这些证据. 因此,漫游可以支持专家解释和对视觉地面的低成本监测,将可解释性观测转变为一个可操作的推论政策,而无需外部视觉模型或重复解码. 选择性审查集中了对可能失败的额外推论,而不是每一项请求。 因此,额外审查费用只发生在触发的子集上,比审查每项投入减少预期的推断间接费用。

blocks.en: Our contributions include: (a) demonstrating that target-object presence and absence are encoded in target-token routing, with the signal transferring across datasets and exhibiting identifiable layer- and expert-level structure; (b) training model-specific linear probes over layer–expert routing probabilities that identify target-absent inputs with high in-domain accuracy and generalize across two MoE VLM families; and (c) developing a routing-gated review method that improves end-to-end accuracy without modifying model weights, while quantifying the correction gains and false-positive risks of selective intervention.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献包括:(a) 证明目标对象的存在和缺失被编码为目标对象的路由,信号通过数据集传输,并显示可识别的层层和专家层次结构;(b) 培训在层层上具体模型的线性探测器 -- -- 专家的路由概率,确定具有高域内精确度的目标偏差输入,并在两个省VLM家族中加以概括;(c) 开发一种路由化的审查方法,在不修改模型权重的情况下,提高端到端的准确性,同时量化有选择性干预的校正收益和假阳性风险。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Visual Grounding Failures and False-Premise Evaluation
blocks.zh: 2.1 视觉定位失败和虚假评价

blocks.en: Visual grounding evaluation asks whether a model’s claims are supported by the image. Early work measured unsupported object mentions in captions through CHAIR; POPE subsequently made object presence the explicit subject of binary questions ( Rohrbach et al., 2018 ; Li et al., 2023 ) . AMBER extends this evaluation to attributes and relations, recognizing that a response can be visually unsupported even beyond an incorrect existence judgment ( Wang et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 视觉地基评估询问模型的索赔是否得到图像的支持。 早期测量到的无支持对象通过CHAIR在标题中提及;POPE随后将对象存在作为二进制问题的明确主题(Rohrbach等人,2018年;Li等人,2023年). AMBER将这一评价延伸至属性和关系,承认一个反应甚至超越了错误的存在判断(Wang et al., 2023),可以视而不见支持.

blocks.en: False-premise questions expose a different demand: rather than explicitly judging existence, the model must recognize that the requested information presupposes an absent object. NOPE evaluates questions about absent objects, requiring models to acknowledge missing visual evidence instead of supplying a plausible answer ( Lovenia et al., 2024 ) . Removed-object benchmarks make such negatives more challenging by deleting an object that originally belonged to the scene, preserving contextual cues that can still make its presence plausible ( He et al., 2025 ) . We use this setting to study detection and review of target-absence grounding failures, rather than treating every form of visual hallucination as the same prediction task.
blocks.zh: 假象问题暴露出一种不同的要求:模型必须承认所要求的信息以不存在的物体为先决条件,而不是明确判断存在。 NOPE评价关于缺失物体的问题,要求模型承认缺失的视觉证据,而不是提供可信的答案(Lovenia等人,2024年)。 删除对象基准使这种负数更具挑战性,删除了原来属于场景的物体,保留了仍能使其存在合理性的背景提示(He等人,2025年)。 我们利用这个环境来研究检测和审查目标缺失的地面故障,而不是将各种形式的视觉幻觉作为同样的预测任务。

blocks.en: 2.3 MoE Routing Analysis and Behavioral Control
blocks.zh: 2.3 教育部路线分析和行为控制

blocks.en: Because MoE routers allocate tokens to selected experts, their decisions offer a direct view of how computation is organized ( Shazeer et al., 2017 ; Fedus et al., 2022 ) . The organization is not uniform across models: Mixtral reports limited domain specialization, whereas OLMoE identifies clearer domain- and vocabulary-associated routing patterns ( Jiang et al., 2024 ; Muennighoff et al., 2025 ) . Within models, expert diversity and sharing also vary with depth, as shown by cross-model analyses and the middle-layer cross-lingual alignment observed in Multilingual Routing ( Lo et al., 2025 ; Bandarkar et al., 2026 ) . These differences motivate studying routing under specific inputs and layers, rather than assigning a universal functional label to an expert.
blocks.zh: 由于教育部的路由器向选定的专家分配符号,因此他们的决定直接展示了如何组织计算(Shazeer等人,2017年;Fedus等人,2022年). 本组织不同模式之间并不统一: Mixtral报告域域专业有限,而OLMOE则确定了更明确的域和词汇相关路由模式(Jiang等人,2024年;Muennighoff等人,2025年). 在模型中,专家的多样性和分享也因深度而异,这表现在跨模型分析和在多种语言路线中观察到的中层跨语言对齐(Lo等人,2025年;Bandarkar等人,2026年)。 这些差异促使在具体投入和层次下研究路由,而不是将通用功能标签分配给专家。

blocks.en: Once routing patterns are associated with a behavior, they can also become targets for intervention. SteerMoE and RICE exploit this connection through inference-time expert steering, while Router Lens identifies context-faithful experts for selective fine-tuning ( Fayyaz et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Bai et al., 2025 ) . These approaches use expert analysis to alter the model’s computation or parameters. Our use is instead observational: unchanged routing supplies features for an absence detector, whose output selects a review prompt rather than directly steering experts.
blocks.zh: 一旦路线模式与某一行为相关联,它们也可以成为干预的目标. FirdMoE和RICE通过推论时间专家指导利用这种联系,而路由器Lens则确定有选择地微调符合背景的专家(Fayyaz等人,2026年;Wang等人,2025年;Bai等人,2025年)。 这些方法利用专家分析来改变模型的计算或参数。 相反,我们的用途是观察:一个缺失探测器的路由功能不变,其产出选择的审查即时,而不是直接指导专家。

blocks.en: 2.4 Visual Verification and Selective Review
blocks.zh: 2.4 视觉核查和选择性审查

blocks.en: Detecting unsupported visual premises is useful only if the resulting signal can guide an appropriate response. Existing mitigation methods provide several correction mechanisms: VCD and OPERA modify decoding, whereas Woodpecker verifies visual claims through an additional correction pipeline ( Leng et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2024 ; Yin et al., 2024 ) . VDGD takes another route, generating an image description and using it to ground subsequent answer decoding ( Ghosh et al., 2025 ) . These methods address how to correct, but the availability of a correction mechanism does not establish that it should be applied to every input.
blocks.zh: 只有在生成的信号能够指导适当的反应时,探测不支持的视觉前提才有用。 现有的缓解方法提供了几种纠正机制:VCD和OPERA修改解码,而Woodpecker则通过额外的纠正管道验证视觉索赔(Leng等人,2024年;Huang等人,2000年)。 2024; 殷等, 2024). VDGD走另一条路线,生成图像描述,并用它来对随后的答案解码进行地面操作(Ghosh等人,2025年)。 这些方法涉及如何纠正,但纠正机制的可用性并不确定它应适用于每一项投入。

blocks.en: Prompted reconsideration can introduce errors as well as resolve them, making the choice of when to intervene part of the reliability problem ( Kamoi et al., 2024 ) . RSP explicitly addresses this choice by thresholding pre-generation attention entropy or first-token confidence to trigger verification, without training a detector ( Huang et al., 2026 ) . Its input-dependent benefits and harms motivate selective review, while leaving room for task-specific signals beyond general uncertainty ( Huang et al., 2026 ) . We instantiate this selection with a supervised target-absence probe over MoE routing, linking its prediction to target-aware review and evaluating the resulting correction–harm trade-off.
blocks.zh: 迅速重新审议既可以产生错误,也可以解决问题,从而可以选择何时干预部分可靠性问题(Kamoi等人,2024年)。 RSP明确解决了这一选择,在不训练探测器的情况下,将产生前的注意力的entropy或第一手的置信度设定阈值以触发核查(Huang等人,2026年)。 其投入依赖的利弊刺激了选择性审查,同时为特定任务信号留出了超出一般不确定性的空间(Huang等人,2026年). 我们用一个监督目标缺失的探测器对教育部的路径进行即时分析,将预测与目标意识审查联系起来,并评估由此产生的纠正-损害权衡。

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: We consider a single-image detection and correction setting. Each example consists of an image I i I_{i} , a question q i q_{i} referring to a target object, and a binary label y i ∈ { 0 , 1 } y_{i}\in\{0,1\} , where y i = 1 y_{i}=1 indicates that the target is absent and y i = 0 y_{i}=0 indicates that the target is present. Controlled target-present and target-absent images may originate from the same source scene, but every ( I i , q i ) (I_{i},q_{i}) is processed independently. The method follows the same order as inference. We first extract routing at the target-object tokens, then use it to estimate target absence, and finally invoke visual review only when that estimate exceeds a threshold.

blocks.en: 3.1 Target-Token Routing Representation
blocks.zh: 3.1 目标流动代表

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Model and data. We train a separate routing probe for each of two MoE VLMs, Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct and Gemma-4-26B-A4B-it, using 20,000 training pairs, 5,446 validation pairs, and 5,776 test pairs. All pairs pass automatic quality control, and images from the same source scene stay in the same split. Each pair contains one target-present image and one target-absent image. For the review experiment, we use 120 manually audited pairs from GQA and 115 manually audited pairs from OBER (filtering 5 with ambiguous semantics). Target presence in the original image and the absence of all same-category objects in the edited image are manually checked. The appendix gives the full data and annotation details.
blocks.zh: 模型与数据. 我们为两个MOE VLM,Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct和Gemma-4-26B-A4B-it各培训一个单独的路由探测器,使用2万对训练对,5,446对验证对,5,776对试验对. 所有对子都通过自动质量控制,来自同一源场景的图像保持相同的分割. 每对都包含一个目标存在的图像和一个目标缺失的图像. 对于审查实验,我们使用来自GQA的120对手动审核对和来自OBER的115对手动审核对(Filtering 5带有模糊语义). 手动检查原始图像中的目标存在以及编辑图像中没有所有同类对象。 附录提供了全部数据和说明的细节。

blocks.en: Review process. We test three prompts: standard, generic review, and target-aware review. Generic review asks the model to inspect the image before answering, and target-aware review asks it to check whether the target object is present. We sample five answers for each image–question pair under each prompt. Review is triggered when the detector score exceeds the model’s calibrated threshold. We select each threshold on GQA validation and keep the standard answer when review is not triggered. The appendix gives the prompts, generation settings, training details, and thresholds.
blocks.zh: 5. 审查过程。 我们测试三个提示:标准、通用审查和目标意识审查。 通用审查要求模型在回答之前检查图像,目标意识审查要求它检查目标对象是否存在. 我们为每个图像抽样5个答案, 当探测器得分超过模型的校准阈值时,即触发检讨. 我们在GQA验证上选择每个阈值,并在审查没有触发时保留标准答案. 附录给出了提示、生成设置、培训细节和阈值。

blocks.en: Evaluation protocol. Generated answers, including the added always-review answers, are manually checked against the images; Appendix A.1 gives the scoring rules. We report ROC-AUC for detector ranking and accuracy at the chosen threshold. ROC-AUC measures how well the detector ranks absent images above present images, and accuracy is the fraction of correctly classified images. Absence recall is the fraction of absent images sent to review, and specificity is the fraction of present images that do not trigger review. Trigger rate is the fraction of all images sent to review. Policy accuracy is the fraction of correct final answers across both present and absent images, so it counts both corrections and errors caused by review.
blocks.zh: 评估协议。 生成的答案,包括添加的总是审查的答案,会对照图像进行人工检查;附录A.1给出了评分规则. 我们报告ROC-AUC在选定阈值上的探测器排名和准确性. ROC-AUC测量探测器在目前图像上方没有的图像的排列情况,精确度是正确分类图像的一小部分. 缺失召回是发送审查的缺失图像的一小部分,特异性是当前图像中不会触发审查的一小部分. 触发速率是发送审查的所有图像的一小部分. 政策准确性是当前和缺失图像中正确最后答案的一小部分,因此它既计算审查造成的更正,也计算错误.

blocks.en: 4.2.1 Routing Gate Reliability

blocks.en: Reliable detection is the first step in deciding which inputs need review. On the frozen GQA-Inpaint test split, Qwen and Gemma achieve 0.9988 and 0.9956 ROC-AUC (98.54% and 96.68% accuracy; Fig. 2 ). Thus, target-token routing can predict target absence before the model answers.
blocks.zh: 可靠的检测是决定哪些投入需要审查的第一步。 在冷冻的GQA-Inpaint测试分裂上,Quen和Gemma实现0.998和0.9956 ROC-AUC(98.54%和96.68%的精度;图2 ) 。 因此,靶位路由可以在模型解答前预测目标缺失.

blocks.en: As a control, we repeat Gemma probe training 20 times with separately shuffled training and validation labels. We select probes using the shuffled validation labels, then evaluate them against the true validation labels. Their ROC-AUC is 0.515 ± 0.062 0.515\pm 0.062 , close to chance.

blocks.en: We compare routing with three target-token representation baselines: input embeddings, the mean hidden state across layers, and the final-layer hidden state. The first averages the target tokens’ text embeddings before decoder processing, so it represents the target phrase without image context. The second averages the target-token hidden states across all decoder layers, capturing the representation after the model processes the image and question. The final-layer baseline uses the target-token hidden state from Layer 47 without averaging across layers. Each baseline yields 2,048 features, compared with the 6,144 layer–expert probabilities used by our routing probe. We train an L2-regularized linear probe for each representation using the same GQA-Inpaint examples, splits, and target-token spans, and select regularization and thresholds on validation data.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了路由与三个目标式的表示基线:输入嵌入,层层间平均隐藏状态,以及最终层隐藏状态. 第一个平均值是目标符的文本在解码器处理之前嵌入,因此它代表了没有图像上下文的目标短语. 第二个平均值是所有解码层中的目标键隐藏状态,在模型处理图像和问题后捕捉到代表. 终层基线使用来自47层的目标托肯隐藏状态,不跨层平均. 每个基线的特性为2,048个,而我们的路线探测器使用的是6,144层的专家概率。 我们使用相同的GQA-Inpaint实例、拆分和标杆跨度,为每个代表点培训一个L2-正规线性探测器,并在验证数据上选择规范化和阈值。

blocks.en: Table 1 shows that input embeddings give chance-level detection, whereas mean hidden states reach 0.9979 ROC-AUC and 98.06% accuracy. All-layer routing performs slightly better, reaching 0.9988 ROC-AUC and 98.54% accuracy. Routing thus offers a small performance gain over the mean-hidden-state baseline while retaining explicit layer–expert coordinates. These coordinates let us identify which expert probabilities contribute to the probe’s prediction and examine their distribution across layers in Section 4.3 .

The gate preserves most correct present-image answers. Across both groups, selective review outperforms always review on GQA (89.00% versus 86.25%) and OBER (95.57% versus 95.30%), while avoiding 49.58% and 16.09% of review calls, respectively. The OBER accuracy difference is small. Appendix A.4 reports the generic-control results (Tables 12 and 11 ).
blocks.zh: 表2 离职 Wen通过真实目标出现的结果. 目标意识审查对缺失的图像产生收益,同时总是审查现有图像降低其准确性。 大门保存着最正确的现成答案. 在这两个组中,选择性审查的业绩总是超过全球质量评估(89.0%对86.25%)和OPER(95.57%对95.30%),同时分别避免49.58%和16.09%的审查电话。 OBER精度差小. 附录A.4报告了通用控制结果(表12和表11)。

blocks.en: 4.2.3 Correction on Triggered Absent Images
blocks.zh: 4.2.3 对触发缺失图像的更正

blocks.en: To isolate correction after a trigger, we also evaluate target-absent images sent to review. Target-aware review raises Qwen’s OBER accuracy from 66.49% to 95.79%. Gemma starts at 93.10% on this subset and reaches 100%; its smaller gain reflects the limited room for improvement. Appendix Figure 9 gives all four model–dataset comparisons, including GQA.
blocks.zh: 为了在触发后隔离校正,我们还评估发送审查的目标缺失图像。 目标认知审查将Quen的OPER精度从66.49%提高到95.79%. Gemma在这一子集上以93.10%开始,达到100%;其较小的收益反映了有限的改进空间. 附录图9列出所有四个模型-数据集比较,包括GQA.

blocks.en: 4.2.4 Cost of False Triggers
blocks.zh: 4.2.4 假触发器的成本

blocks.en: To assess the cost of an incorrect review decision, we examine target-present images that the detector classifies as absent. We measure harm as the fraction of initially correct answers on these images that become wrong after review.
blocks.zh: 为了评估不正确的审查决定的费用,我们审查了探测器归类为缺失的目标显示图像。 我们测量伤害,作为这些图像上最初正确答案的一小部分,这些图像经过审查后变成错误的.

blocks.en: Figure 5: Correct-to-wrong harm after false review triggers. Bars show the percentage of initially correct answers on target-present images that become wrong after review; labels give the numerator and denominator. Qwen has 2 false-triggered images in GQA and 79 in OBER; Gemma has 2 and 36, respectively. Each image has five sampled answers.
blocks.zh: 图5:错审触发后对错的伤害. 栏显示在目标显示的图像上最初正确的答案在审核后会变成错误的百分比;标签给出数字和分母. Quen在GQA中拥有2个假触发图像,在OBER中拥有79个;Gemma分别拥有2个和36个. 每个图像都有5个抽样答案.

blocks.en: Figure 5 shows that, across both datasets, generic review changes 4 of 405 initially correct Qwen answers to wrong answers (0.99%), while target-aware review changes 32 (7.90%). Gemma shows the same pattern, with 10 of 188 answers becoming wrong under generic review (5.32%) and 15 under target-aware review (7.98%). The GQA results also differ between models: target-aware review harms 5 of 10 initially correct Qwen answers but none of the 10 Gemma answers. However, each GQA subset contains only two images with five sampled answers per image, so these rates provide limited evidence about dataset-level risk.
blocks.zh: 图5显示,在两个数据集中,一般审查的变化为405个,初步正确 Quen回答错误的回答(0.99%),而目标意识审查则改变32(7.90%). Gemma显示了同样的模式,188个答复中有10个在一般审查(5.32%)中出现错误,15个在目标意识审查(7.98%)中出现错误。 全球质量评估结果也因模型不同而不同:目标意识审查损害为10分之5初步正确 Quen回答但10个Gemma都没有回答. 然而,每个GQA子集只包含两个图像,每个图像有五个抽样答案,因此这些速率对数据集级风险提供了有限的证据.

blocks.en: Together with the correction gains in Appendix Figure 9 , these results show a trade-off: target-aware review corrects more absent-object answers, but causes more harm when present objects trigger review.
blocks.zh: 这些结果与附录图9中的校正收益一起,显示了一种权衡:目标意识审查更正了更多缺席对象答案,但当当前对象触发审查时造成更多伤害.

blocks.en: 4.3 Analysis Experiments
blocks.zh: 4.3 分析实验

blocks.en: The main results show that routing can detect target absence and guide review. The following analyses examine how this information is used by the probe and where it can be read from the model. We first examine how predictive weight is distributed across experts, and then test whether the early-layer pattern identified by the full probe is independently predictive.
blocks.zh: 主要结果显示,路由可以发现目标缺失并指导审查. 以下分析研究了该探测器如何使用这一信息以及从模型中可读到的信息。 我们首先研究预测重量如何在专家之间分布,然后测试全探测器确定的早期图案是否具有独立的预测性.

blocks.en: Table 3: Highest-ranked experts by absolute mean standardized weight. Signs indicate the direction of the absence score.
blocks.zh: 表3:按绝对平均标准权重分列的排名最高的专家。 标志表示缺席分数的方向.

blocks.en: 4.3.1 Expert Weight Distribution
blocks.zh: 4.3.1 专家重量分配

blocks.en:
Table 3 lists the eight experts with the largest absolute mean standardized coefficients in the full 6,144-feature linear probe, averaged across three training seeds. Positive weights increase the predicted absence score, while negative weights decrease it. Four of these experts are in Layer 2, although experts from later layers also appear in the list. This concentration suggests that target-absence information emerges in an early layer, but the ranking alone cannot establish whether that layer supports detection on its own. Expert weight ranking details are provided in Appendix A.7 . This early signal is consistent with how models integrate visual information: a vision encoder first extracts image features, which enter the language decoder alongside text tokens, allowing attention to incorporate visual context into target-token representations.
Qwen3-VL additionally injects intermediate vision-encoder features into its first three decoder layers through DeepStack. These pathways could explain why target-token routing becomes informative early.
blocks.zh:
表3列出了全部6,144个地貌线性探测器中绝对平均标准化系数最大的8名专家,平均分布在3个训练种子中。 正重会增加预测的缺勤分数,负重则会减少. 其中4位专家位于第2层,不过来自后层的专家也在列表中出现. 这种集中表明,目标缺失信息在早期层中出现,但单靠排名无法确定该层本身是否支持检测. 专家权重排名详情见附录A.7。 这个早期的信号与模型如何整合视觉信息是一致的:一个视觉编码器首先提取图像特征,它们与文本符号一起输入语言解码器,使得注意力能够将视觉上下文融入到目标托肯表达中.
Qune3-VL通过DeepStack额外将中间视觉-编码器特征注入其前三个解码层. 这些路径可以解释为什么目标移动路由会很早就得到信息。

blocks.en: Figure 6 (a) extends this view to all experts, with one row per layer and one column per expert. Larger positive and negative weights are more visible in the early layers, providing another sign that the absence signal may emerge early. At the same time, weights spread across many layers and experts; the largest coefficient accounts for only 0.164% of the sum of absolute coefficients. The full probe therefore uses a broad set of features rather than relying on one expert. These weights show how the probe uses routing features, not the causal role of each expert. Feature correlations and regularization also affect weight size, so the heatmap cannot tell us whether an early layer can detect absence by itself. We test this possibility with separate probes for each layer.
blocks.zh: 图6(a)将这一看法扩大到所有专家,每层一行,每专家一列。 较大的正负分量在早期层中更加明显,提供了另一个信号,即缺失信号可能提前出现. 同时,权重分布在许多层和专家之间;最大系数仅占绝对系数总和的0.164%. 因此,完整的探测器使用一系列广泛的特征,而不是依赖一位专家。 这些权重显示了探测器如何使用路由特征,而不是每个专家的因果作用. 特征相关性和规范化也影响重量大小,因此热映射无法告诉我们早期的层本身是否能够检测缺失. 我们用每层的探测器测试这种可能性。

blocks.en: Figure 6: Routing analysis in Qwen. (a) Standardized coefficients of the full 6,144-feature probe, averaged across three training seeds. Red and blue indicate positive and negative weights; the color scale is clipped at the 99th percentile of absolute weights. (b) Test ROC-AUC of 48 single-layer probes. The dashed line shows the full 48-layer probe and the marker highlights Layer 2.
blocks.zh: 图6:Quen的运行分析。 (a) 全部6 144个地形探测器的标准系数,平均分为三个训练种子。 红色和蓝色表示正负重量;颜色尺度在绝对重量的第99百分位被剪切. (b) 测试48个单层探测器的ROC-AUC。 虚线显示全48层探测器,标记突出第2层.

blocks.en: 4.3.2 Layer-Wise Detection
blocks.zh: 4.3.2 层宽探测

blocks.en: To test the early-layer pattern in the heatmap, we train a separate linear probe on the 128 routing probabilities from each of Qwen’s 48 MoE layers. All probes use the same data splits and training procedure, with model selection based on validation performance. Figure 6 (b) compares their test ROC-AUC with the full 6,144-feature probe, shown as a dashed line. Layer 1 is the first to exceed 0.90 validation ROC-AUC, and Layer 2 is the best single layer selected on validation. Layer 2 reaches 0.9836 test ROC-AUC and 94.33% accuracy using only 128 features, compared with 0.9988 ROC-AUC for the full probe. This confirms that a strong absence signal can already be read from Layer 2, rather than merely receiving large weights in the full probe. Combining all layers still improves detection, so the early-layer probe does not capture all of the useful information. Table 14 in the appendix reports test ROC-AUC and accuracy for all 48 classifiers.
blocks.zh: 为了测试热图中早期的图案,我们从Quen的48个MOE层的每个层中,对128个路由概率进行单独的线性探测。 所有探测器都使用相同的数据分割和培训程序,模型选择基于验证性能. 图6(b)将其试验的ROC-AUC与显示为破折线的全6,144个地形探测器进行比较。 第一层是第一个超过0.90的验证ROC-AUC,第2层是在验证时选定的最佳单层. 第2层仅使用128个特性,达到0.9836个测试ROC-AUC和94.33%的精度,而全探测器则使用0.9988个ROC-AUC. 这证实了强烈的缺失信号已经可以从第2层读取,而不只是在全探测器中接收大量重量. 结合所有层仍能改进检测,因此早期层探测器无法捕捉所有有用的信息. 附录报告中的表14测试了ROC-AUC以及所有48个分类器的准确性。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
Target-token routing probabilities in MoE VLMs reveal whether a queried object is absent from the image, even when the model’s answer accepts the false premise.
We use this signal to selectively trigger target-aware visual review, improving final-answer accuracy by up to 22.25 percentage points for Qwen and 13.42 percentage points for Gemma across GQA-Inpaint and OBER, without modifying model weights or router parameters.
Our analyses of Qwen reveal that target-absence information is accessible in early MoE layers and distributed across experts, highlighting a gap between the visual evidence encoded in routing and the model’s final answers.
These findings show that routing signals already computed by an MoE VLM can guide selective review and help the model produce answers that better reflect the available visual evidence.
blocks.zh:
在MOE VLMs中的目标键路由概率显示,即使模型的答案接受虚假前提,图像中是否没有被询问的对象。
我们利用这个信号有选择地触发目标感知视觉审查,将Qwen的最终回答精度提高22.25个百分点,Gemma在GQA-Inpaint和OBER上提高13.42个百分点,而不修改模型权重或路由参数.
我们对Quen的分析显示,目标缺失信息可以在教育部早期的层层中获取,并且分布在专家之间,这凸显了路径编码中的视觉证据与模型最后答案之间的差距。
这些调查结果表明,由MOE VLM已经计算的路由信号可以指导选择性审查,帮助模型产生更好地反映现有视觉证据的答案.

blocks.en: A.1 Data and Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: A.1 数据和评价协议

blocks.en: The probe cohort selects 31,222 GQA-Inpaint image pairs that passed automatic quality control. We use 20,000 pairs for training, 5,446 for validation, and 5,776 for held-out testing. Each pair contributes one target-present and one target-absent single-image example. Images derived from the same source scene remain in the same split, and the probe never receives a pair difference. The GQA review cohort contains 120 pairs, with 60 drawn from the validation split and 60 from the test split. It is used for policy evaluation, not as an independent detector test. The external OBER review cohort contains 115 pairs. These are the primary pairs remaining after 30 of 150 initial candidates were removed during data preparation and five more were excluded for ambiguous image–label semantics.

blocks.en: A.2 Models, Routing Features, and Probe Training
blocks.zh: A.2 模式、常规特征和勘探培训

blocks.en: Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct has 48 MoE layers with 128 experts per layer, giving 6,144 layer–expert probabilities. Gemma-4-26B-A4B-it has 30 MoE layers with 128 experts per layer, giving 3,840 probabilities. Both models are loaded in bfloat16 and execute the Top-8 selected experts at each layer, but our representation retains the full pre-selection probability distribution. We log routing at the automatically extracted target-object token span during standard prompt prefill and average across sub-tokens for multi-token targets. The two models use separate probes; no model or router weights are changed. On the controlled audited question templates, the extractor recovered the exact target phrase and tokenizer span for all 240 GQA and pre-exclusion OBER questions, including 61 multi-token targets. This result does not establish extraction accuracy on unrestricted questions.
blocks.zh: Qune3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct 拥有48个MOE层,每层有128位专家,给出了6,144层–专家概率. Gemma-4-26B-A4B-it拥有30个MOE层,每层有128位专家,给出了3,840个概率. 这两个模型都装入bfloat16,并在每一层执行TOP-8选定的专家,但我们的代表保留了全部预选概率分布. 我们在标准即时预填时,在自动提取的目标对象标志间距上记录路径,并在多键目标下记录平均值。 两种模型使用独立的探测器;没有改变模型或路由器重量. 在受控审计的问题模板上,提取器回收了所有240 GQA 和预排除 OBER 问题的精确目标短语和标语间隔,包括61个多键目标. 这一结果不能确定不受限制问题的提取准确性。

blocks.zh: 表7:对两个数据集采用GQA-验证-选定阈值冻结的探测器性能。 准确性、召回、具体性和触发率是百分比。 经审计的GQA是一个包含验证图像的政策组.

blocks.en: The Qwen input-embedding and hidden-state baselines use the same GQA examples, source-scene splits, and target-token spans as the routing probe. Each representation has 2,048 dimensions, compared with 6,144 routing dimensions. An L2-regularized linear probe is trained and selected separately for each representation. The text-only input embeddings give 0.5000 test ROC-AUC and 50.00% accuracy. Mean hidden states give 0.9979 ROC-AUC and 98.06% accuracy; the last hidden layer gives 0.9980 and 98.16%. All-layer routing gives 0.9988 and 98.54%. Table 8 lists each single-hidden-layer probe. Several hidden layers are also highly predictive, so this does not show that routing is better than every hidden-state representation. Each routing coordinate, however, names a layer and expert. This comparison uses Qwen and GQA, not Gemma or OBER.
blocks.zh: Quen输入-嵌入和隐藏状态基线使用相同的GQA实例,源-场分裂,目标-托肯间距作为路由探测器. 每个代表的尺寸为2,048个,而路由尺寸为6,144个。 对L2正规线性探测器进行了培训,并为每个代表物分别选定。 仅文本输入嵌入给0.5000测试ROC-AUC和50.0%的精度. 平均隐藏状态给出了0.9979 ROC-AUC和98.06%的精度;最后一个隐藏层给出了0.9980和98.16%. 全层路由给予0.9988和98.54%. 表8列出每个单层隐藏探测器. 几个隐藏层也具有很高的预测性,因此这并不表明路由比每个隐藏状态的表示要好. 但是,每个路由协调器都指定了一层和专家。 这种比较使用Quen和GQA,而不是Gemma或OBER.

blocks.en: Table 8: Qwen target-token hidden-state probes on the GQA-Inpaint held-out test split. Each probe uses one decoder layer and the same data splits as the routing probe. Regularization and thresholds are selected on validation data. Layer indices start at zero; accuracy is a percentage.
blocks.zh: 表8:GQA-Inpaint悬浮测试分裂上的Quen目标托肯隐藏状态探测器. 每个探测器使用一个解码器层,数据与路由探测器相同。 在验证数据上选择了规范化和阈值. 层指数从零开始;精确度是百分比。

blocks.en: The frozen GQA-to-OBER results above require no OBER labels for threshold selection. As a separate diagnostic, we split the 115 OBER pairs into 57 calibration and 58 evaluation pairs, keeping both images from a pair together. We repeat this grouped split 200 times. For each repetition, we choose the threshold on the calibration pairs and evaluate it only on the other pairs. Table 9 gives held-out means. For Qwen, mean OBER balanced accuracy rises from 65.22% with its frozen GQA threshold to 77.75% after local calibration; for Gemma, it rises from 70.87% to 73.19%. These diagnostic numbers are not the zero-shot policy results, because local calibration uses labeled OBER examples. Threshold changes alter recall, specificity, and trigger rate, but do not improve ROC-AUC on a fixed set of examples. They also do not establish why the OBER ranking AUC is lower.
blocks.zh: 以上冻结的GQA至OBER结果不需要OBER标签来选择阈值. 作为单独的诊断,我们把115个OBER对分为57个校准对和58个评价对,使两个图像从一对保持在一起. 我们重复这一组200次。 对于每次重复,我们都会在校准对对上选择阈值,只在其他对对上评价. 表9列出被搁置手段。 对Quen来说,OBER的平衡精度从冷冻GQA阈值的65.22%上升到本地校准后的77.75%;对Gemma来说,它从70.87%上升到73.19%. 这些诊断数字不是零镜头政策结果,因为本地校准使用标注为OBER的例子. 阈值变化会改变召回率,特异性,和触发率,但不会在固定的一组示例上改进ROC-AUC. 他们也没有确定为什么OBER排名AUC较低.

blocks.en: An initial Gemma shuffled-label run gave 0.4323 ROC-AUC, outside the original [ 0.45 , 0.55 ] [0.45,0.55] stopping interval. Widening that interval to [ 0.4 , 0.6 ] [0.4,0.6] after observing the result is not independent evidence. We therefore repeated the control 20 times with independently shuffled training and validation labels. Each run selects its epoch with shuffled validation labels and is then evaluated against true validation labels. The mean ROC-AUC is 0.5151 ± 0.0618 0.5151\pm 0.0618 , consistent with chance; Figure 7 shows the full distribution and initial run.
blocks.zh: 最初的Gemmashuffled-label运行给了0.4323 ROC-AUC,在原[0.45,0.55] [0.45,0.55]停止间隔. 将观测结果后的间隔扩大至[0.4,0.6][0.4,0.6]不是独立证据. 因此,我们重复了20次控制,并用独立的洗牌培训和验证标签。 每个运行会选择带有shuffled验证标签的时代,然后根据真实验证标签进行评价. ROC-AUC的平均值为0.5151±0.0618 0.5151/pm0.0618,与机会一致; 图7显示全部分布和初步运行情况。

blocks.en: Table 9: OBER threshold sensitivity. Calibration uses 200 pair-grouped 50/50 calibration–evaluation splits; the split-calibrated values are held-out means. All rate columns are percentages.
blocks.zh: 表9:OBER阈值敏感性. 校准使用200对组合的50/50校准-评价拆分;拆分校准的值是持有的表示. 所有费率栏均为百分比。

blocks.en: Figure 7: Gemma validation ROC-AUC after 20 independently shuffled-label runs. The dashed line marks chance; the red line marks the original single run.
blocks.zh: 图7:Gemma验证 ROC-AUC在20个独立洗牌标签运行后. 虚线标志机缘;红线标志原单跑.

blocks.en: A.4 Additional Review-Policy Results
blocks.zh: A.4 其他审查-政策成果

blocks.en: Table 10 gives the values plotted in the main paper. Each accuracy is computed across both target-present and target-absent images. A reviewed answer replaces the standard answer only when the model-specific detector exceeds its frozen GQA threshold. The target-aware gain is an absolute percentage-point difference from standard answering.
blocks.zh: 表10列出了主要文件中绘制的数值。 每种准确度在目标存在和目标缺失的图像中计算。 一个经审查的答案只有在模型特定探测器超过其冻结的GQA阈值时才能替换标准答案. 目标意识增益与标准回答的绝对百分比差.

blocks.en: Table 10: End-to-end answer accuracy for standard generation and two routing-gated review prompts. All values except gain are percentages.
blocks.zh: 表10 标准生成的端对端答精度和两个路由定点审查提示. 除收益外,所有价值均为百分比。

blocks.en: Qwen’s target-aware gain is positive in all five sampled repetitions on each dataset (Figure 8 ). Mean gains are 22.25 ± 0.23 22.25\pm 0.23 points on GQA and 12.17 ± 0.81 12.17\pm 0.81 on OBER. These repetitions test sampling stability on the same images, not independent dataset replication.
blocks.zh: Quen的目标认知收益在每个数据集的所有五个抽样重复中都是积极的(图8)。 平均收益为GQA22.25±0.23 22.25\pm0.23分,OBER12.17±0.81 12.17\pm0.81分. 这些重复在相同的图像上测试采样稳定性,而不是独立的数据集复制.

blocks.en: Figure 8: Qwen target-aware accuracy gains across five sampled generations per image. Points show individual repetitions; diamonds show dataset means.
blocks.zh: 图8:每幅图像5代样本的Quen目标感知精度提高。 点显示单个重复; 钻石显示数据集手段 。

blocks.en: For Qwen, selective and always review use the same 120 GQA and 115 OBER pairs, prompts, and five sampled answers per image. With target-aware review, selective accuracy exceeds always-review accuracy on GQA (89.00% versus 86.25%) and OBER (95.57% versus 95.30%). The gate sends 50.42% of GQA images and 83.91% of OBER images to review, compared with 100% under always review. Thus, it avoids 49.58% and 16.09% of potential review calls, respectively. This comparison evaluates review-call count under both the in-domain and shifted cohorts; it does not measure end-to-end latency, energy, or FLOPs.
blocks.zh: 对于Quen,选择性且总是审查使用相同的120 GQA和115 OBER对,提示,以及每个图像的五个抽样答案. 通过目标意识审查,选择性精度超过了总的审查精度:GQA(89.00 %对86.25%)和OPER(95.57%对95.30%)。 大门发送了50.42%的GQA图像和83.91%的OBER图像供审查,而100%的图像总是在审查中. 因此,它分别避免了49.58%和16.09%的潜在审查电话。 这种比较评估了域内和转移组别下的审查-呼叫计数;它不衡量端到端延迟、能量或FLOP。

blocks.en: Table 11: Qwen selective versus always review with manually checked answers. Accuracy combines target-present and target-absent inputs. Always review has a 100% review rate; the final column gives the selective rate.
blocks.zh: 表11:用人工检查的答案对文进行选择性审查。 准确性结合了目标存在和目标缺失的投入. 总是审查有100%的审查率;最后一栏给出了选择性的比率。

blocks.en: Table 12 separates present and absent images. Generic review controls for asking the model to inspect the image without explicitly checking the target. Target-aware review gives much larger gains on absent images but can reduce accuracy on present images, especially when applied to every input.
blocks.zh: 表12分别显示和缺少图像。 一般性审查控制,要求模型检查图像而不明确检查目标. 目标意识审查对缺失的图像有更大的收益,但可以降低当前图像的准确性,特别是在适用于每个输入时。

blocks.en: Table 12: Qwen accuracy (%) by true target presence. Each condition has 600 sampled answers on GQA or 575 on OBER. Selective review keeps the standard answer when the gate does not trigger; always review replaces every answer.
blocks.zh: 表12:按实际目标存在分列的文的准确性(%)。 每个条件都有600个GQA或575OBER的抽样答案. 选择性审查在门没有触发时保留标准答案;总是审查取代每一个答案.

blocks.en: Figure 9 compares standard, generic, and target-aware answers on target-absent images sent to review. This subset excludes absent images missed by the gate, so its denominator differs slightly from the full absent rows of Table 12 . The triggered subset may also differ between Qwen and Gemma.
blocks.zh: 图9比较了发送审查的目标缺失图像的标准、通用和目标意识答案。 这个子集排除了门漏掉的缺失图像,因此它的分母与表12的全缺行略有不同. 触发的子集也可能在Quen和Gemma之间有所不同.

blocks.en: Figure 9: Answer accuracy on target-absent images that trigger review, shown separately for GQA and OBER. Within each model and dataset, all three prompts use the same triggered subset with five answers per image. Gains are target-aware accuracy minus standard accuracy, in percentage points.
blocks.zh: 图9:对触发审查的目标缺失图像进行准确回答,分别显示在GQA和OPER上. 在每一个模型和数据集中,所有三个提示都使用相同的触发子集,每个图像有五个答案. 增益为目标意识准确度减去标准准确度,以百分点计.

blocks.en: Selective and always target-aware review differ only on inputs that the gate predicts are present. On GQA true-present inputs in this group, always review changes 39 correct answers to wrong ones and fixes two wrong answers; on true-absent inputs, it fixes four answers that selective review leaves unchanged. The net selective advantage is therefore 33/1200 answers, or 2.75 points. On OBER, always review changes three correct present answers to wrong ones and fixes none among the skipped inputs; the net advantage is 3/1150 answers, or 0.26 points. A pair-clustered bootstrap (5,000 resamples) gives 95% intervals of [ 1.17 , 4.58 ] [1.17,4.58] and [ 0 , 0.70 ] [0,0.70] points for these overall differences. The OBER gain is small and its interval includes zero.
blocks.zh: 选择性的、始终具有目标意识的审查仅在闸门所预测的投入方面有所不同。 关于本组中GQA真实存在的输入,总是审查39个对错误的正确答案,并修正两个错误答案;关于真实存在的输入,它修正了四个答案,选择性的审查保留不变. 因此净选择性优势是33/1200答案,即2.75分. 在 OBER 上, 总是审查三个正确的当前答案 错误的答案, 并且没有修正任何跳过输入; 净优势是 3/ 1150 答案, 或 0. 26 点 。 双组装的靴子(5,000个复标)为这些总体差异提供95%的间隔[1.17, 4.58] [1.17,4.58]和[0, 0.70]分。 OBER增益很小,其间隔包括0.

blocks.en: Table 13 expands the false-trigger plot in the main paper. The denominator is the number of initially correct answers on target-present images sent to review, not the number of independent images. Qwen has two such images in GQA and 79 in OBER; Gemma has two and 36. Among Qwen’s 405 eligible answers, generic review changes the wording of 314 (77.53%) but makes only four wrong; target-aware review changes 317 (78.27%) but makes 32 wrong. A changed answer is therefore not necessarily a harmed answer. Target-aware review changes fewer than 8% of these initially correct answers to wrong answers after pooling datasets for either model, but the two-image GQA subsets are too small for a stable per-dataset risk estimate. The full policy results above show that this harm does not erase the net accuracy gain.
blocks.zh: 表13扩展了主论文中的假触发情节. 分母是发送审查的目标到现在的图像上最初正确答案的数量,而不是独立图像的数量. Quen在GQA有两幅这样的图像,在OBER有79幅;Gemma有两幅和36幅. 在Quen的405个合格答案中,一般审查修改了314(77.53%)的措辞,但只错误了4个;目标意识审查修改了317(78.27%),但错误了32个。 因此,改变答案不一定是受到损害的答案。 目标认知审查在为两个模型集合数据集后,对错误答案的最初正确答案的修改不到8%,但双图像GQA子集太小,无法对每个数据集的稳定风险估计. 上述政策的全部结果表明,这种伤害并不能抹去净准确性收益。

blocks.en: Table 13: Correct-to-wrong changes among initially correct answers on false-triggered target-present images. Each cell shows the number of harmed answers over the eligible answer count. Five answers from one image are correlated.
blocks.zh: 表13:在错误触发的目标显示图像上对最初正确答案中的正确到错误变化。 每个单元格在合格答案数中显示受害答案数。 一个图像的五个答案是相互关联的。

blocks.en: A.5 Layer-Wise Routing
blocks.zh: A.5 层宽线程

blocks.en: For each of Qwen’s 48 MoE layers, we train a separate linear probe using only that layer’s 128 routing probabilities. All runs follow the same split and validation-selection rules. Table 14 provides test ROC-AUC and accuracy for every layer. Indices are zero-based. Layer 0 reaches 0.8990 validation and 0.9006 test ROC-AUC, so Layer 1 is the first above 0.90 on validation. Layer 2 is best on validation and reaches 0.9836 test ROC-AUC and 94.33% accuracy, versus 0.9988 ROC-AUC for all layers.
blocks.zh: 对于Quen的48个MOE层中的每一层,我们只使用该层128的路由概率来训练一个单独的线性探测器。 所有运行都遵循相同的分割和验证-选择规则. 表14提供了每个层的ROC-AUC测试和准确性。 指数为零基. 0层达到0.8990验证,0.9006测试ROC-AUC,因此1层在验证上是第一个高于0.90的. 第2层最擅长验证,达到0.9836测试ROC-AUC和94.33%的精度,而所有层的精确度为0.9988ROC-AUC.

blocks.en: Table 14: Test results for all 48 Qwen layer-wise classifiers. Each classifier uses 128 routing probabilities from one layer. Model selection and thresholds use validation data only. Accuracy is reported as a percentage.
blocks.zh: 表14:所有48个Wen层分级器的测试结果. 每个分类器从一层使用128个路由概率. 模型选择和阈值仅使用验证数据. 准确性按百分比报告。

blocks.en: A.6 Top-K Routing Probes
blocks.zh: A.6 顶级K 搜索

blocks.en: We rank Qwen’s 6,144 routing dimensions by absolute standardized weight in the full linear probe, using training data only. For each prespecified K ∈ { 10 , 50 , 100 , 500 , 1000 , 1500 , 2048 , 4000 , 6144 } K\in\{10,50,100,500,1000,1500,2048,4000,6144\} , we fit a new linear probe on the top K K dimensions. All probes use the same training split, optimizer settings, and validation-based epoch and threshold selection. Figure 3 shows the held-out test results in the main paper. This experiment does not measure VLM latency or FLOPs, because the router still computes its full probability distribution.
blocks.zh: 我们用全线探测器的绝对标准化重量来排列Quen的6,144路由维度,只使用训练数据. 每一个预先指定的 K { { 10, 50, 100, 500, 1000, 1500, 2048, 400, 6144} K\ { } 10, 50, 100, 100, 1000, 1500, 150, 2048, 4000, 6144 } 我们安装了一个新的线性探测器 在 K K 的顶部尺寸上。 所有探测器都使用相同的训练分裂,优化器设置,以及基于验证的时代和门槛选择. 图3显示主要论文中的搁置试验结果。 这个实验没有测量VLM的纬度或FLOP,因为路由器仍然计算其全部概率分布.

blocks.en: A.7 Expert Weight Ranking Details
blocks.zh: A.7 专家体重排名详情

blocks.en: All 6,144 Qwen layer–expert coordinates are ranked by the absolute value of their mean standardized coefficient over three training seeds. Positive coefficients increase the predicted absence score, while negative coefficients decrease it. The top eight appear in Table 3 ; Figure 6 (a) shows the weight distribution across all layers. The complete numeric ranking is supplied as the machine-readable file all_6144_experts_linear_weight_ranking.csv in the supplementary materials rather than repeated as a long PDF table. This is a ranking within the joint linear probe, not standalone expert accuracy or causal importance.
blocks.zh: 总计 6 144 Quen 层 – 专家坐标按其三个训练种子的平均标准化系数的绝对值排序. 正系数增加预测的缺勤分数,负系数则减少. 前八名载于表3;图6(a)显示各层的重量分布。 完整的数字排名作为机器可读文件在补充材料中的所有_6144_专家_线性_量级_等级.csv提供,而不是作为长的PDF表重复. 这是联合线性探测器内部的排名,而不是独立的专家精确度或因果关系.
